99 no Namida.name: 99 no Namida
99 no Namida.summary: Based on the premise that crying helps relieve stress, Bandai Namco aims with "99 Tears" just that, to make the Nintendo DS owners cry. The game takes place in a city where the inhabitants have forgotten how to cry. One day, returning from work, you run into a store called "Source of Tears" and the story begins. The player will have to play at the end of each day one of the 99 stories that the game has chosen for us previously based on a kind of psychoanalysis. According to the response to the story, the game will continue the sequence optimally to provoke crying.

Emily the Strange - Strangerous.name: Emily the Strange: Strangerous
Emily the Strange - Strangerous.summary: Best described as "Professor Laytons Neice" Emily is a a young teenage that is on a quest to find her four missing cats. To do so you must solve crypt puzzles and mini games to progess the story

Hidden Objects - Mystery Stories.name: Hidden Objects: Mystery Stories
Hidden Objects - Mystery Stories.summary:
Find the clues... Solve the crime... Unravel the mystery!

Hidden object game with a good mix of puzzles and types of hidden object scenes.

Storyline starts on a tropical island with a mystery involving a Mayan curse. It continues in Berlin, delving into long buried secrets.

Mahjongg - Ancient Egypt.name: Mahjongg Mysteries: Ancient Egypt
Mahjongg - Ancient Egypt.summary: No place on Earth holds as many mysteries as Egypt! Help adventurers. Michelle Mosley and David Deanfield in their search for the lost temple. Follow clues from the blistering desert sands to the fertile banks of the Nile, finally reaching the mighty pyramids! Only by correctly combining the hieroglyphics will you complete all 300 mahjongg levels. Go for a journey in Adventure Mode, take on your favorite board in Classic Mode, or try one of 11 interesting variations! Welcome to Ancient Egypt!

Petz - Wild Animals - Tigerz.name: Petz Wild Animals Tigerz
Petz - Wild Animals - Tigerz.summary: Tigerz puts you in the role of animal trainers Enzo and Ana, who are tasked with raising two endangered tiger cubs. Players put on shows and travel the world to save the family company from bankruptcy.

Pony Luv.name: Pony Luv
Pony Luv.summary: Own and manage one of six ponies in Pony Luv.

Puffins - Island Adventure.name: Puffins: Island Adventure
Puffins - Island Adventure.summary: Puffins: Island Adventure is a collection of mini games featuring puffins by developer Other Ocean Interactive and publisher Majesco Entertainment.

Puzzle Series Vol. 8 - Nankuro.name: Puzzle Series Vol. 8: Nankuro
Puzzle Series Vol. 8 - Nankuro.summary: A number crossword game for DS.

Tennis no Ouji-sama - Motto Gakuensai no.name: Tennis no Ouji-sama Motto Gakuensai no Ouji-sama: More Sweet Edition
Tennis no Ouji-sama - Motto Gakuensai no.summary: Nintendo DS port of the PS2 game Tennis no Ouji-sama: Gakuensai no Ouji-sama featuring bonus content and new characters.
